<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="full-task-cycle">
<h1>Full Task Cycle</h1>
<p>This page shows one complete taskledger cycle, from a fresh task through
planning, questions, implementation, validation, and closure. It uses the
strict task-first command grammar:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger [--root PATH] [--json] &lt;area&gt; &lt;verb&gt; [RESOURCE_REF] [--task TASK_REF] [options]
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The examples assume the task is the active task after creation. If another task
is active, add <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--task</span> <span class="pre">parser-fix</span></code> to each task-scoped command.</p>
<section id="initialize-the-ledger">
<h2>1. Initialize The Ledger</h2>
<p>Run this once per workspace:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>init
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>status<span class="w"> </span>--full
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">init</span></code> writes a schema-3 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.toml</span></code> registration and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/taskledger/config.toml</span></code>. Default data is external at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">../ledger</span></code>;
indexes are cache data. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">storage</span> <span class="pre">where</span></code> to inspect paths.</p>
</section>
<section id="create-and-activate-a-task">
<h2>2. Create And Activate A Task</h2>
<p>Create the task, then make it active:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Fix parser edge case&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--slug<span class="w"> </span>parser-fix<span class="w"> </span>--description<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Repair parser handling for nested expressions.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>activate<span class="w"> </span>parser-fix<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Start parser fix&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>active
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>next-action
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">create</span></code> records the task but does not implicitly activate it. Active task
selection is explicit so agents can safely switch between tasks.</p>
<p>Optional setup commands are useful when the task depends on context outside the
description:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>intro<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Parser architecture&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;The parser is staged into tokenize, parse, and normalize passes.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>intro<span class="w"> </span>link<span class="w"> </span>intro-0001
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>file<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--path<span class="w"> </span>taskledger/parser.py<span class="w"> </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span>code<span class="w"> </span>--label<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Parser implementation&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>file<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--path<span class="w"> </span>tests/test_parser.py<span class="w"> </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">test</span><span class="w"> </span>--required-for-validation
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>link<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--url<span class="w"> </span>https://example.invalid/ticket/123<span class="w"> </span>--label<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Support ticket&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Introductions are reusable background notes. File links and external links tell
future planning, implementation, and validation agents where important context
lives.</p>
</section>
<section id="start-planning">
<h2>3. Start Planning</h2>
<p>Start the planning stage and inspect planning context:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>can<span class="w"> </span>plan
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>start
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>planning<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>plan-context<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code> acquires a visible planning lock. The context commands render the
current task, linked files, questions, requirements, and prior records.</p>
</section>
<section id="ask-and-answer-questions">
<h2>4. Ask And Answer Questions</h2>
<p>Questions capture missing decisions before approval:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Should the parser reject or normalize unmatched delimiters?&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--required-for-plan
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Which files must validation cover?&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>open
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>answer-many<span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;q-0001: Reject unmatched delimiters with a clear parse error.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>dismiss<span class="w"> </span>QUESTION_ID<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Validation files are already linked.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>status
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>answers<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">question</span> <span class="pre">answer-many</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">question</span> <span class="pre">answer</span></code> for decisions that should
affect the plan. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">question</span> <span class="pre">dismiss</span></code> when the question is no longer
relevant.</p>
</section>
<section id="propose-a-plan">
<h2>5. Propose A Plan</h2>
<p>Write the plan body in a Markdown file and propose it:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>draft
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>upsert<span class="w"> </span>--file<span class="w"> </span>./plan.md<span class="w"> </span>--criterion<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Parser rejects unmatched delimiters.&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--criterion<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Regression tests cover nested expressions.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>--version<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>diff<span class="w"> </span>--from<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span><span class="w"> </span>--to<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">upsert</span></code> ends the active planning run and creates a reviewable plan
version. Acceptance criteria become validation criteria such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ac-0001</span></code>.</p>
<p>If answers changed after the plan was proposed, regenerate before approval:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>answer-many<span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;q-0001: Reject unmatched delimiters and keep the original token offset.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>upsert<span class="w"> </span>--from-answers<span class="w"> </span>--file<span class="w"> </span>./plan-v2.md
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>--version<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Regeneration keeps the durable answer snapshot aligned with the plan.</p>
<p>For diagnostic commands needed during planning (linting, test runs, code
inspection), preserve their output with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">command</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">command</span><span class="w"> </span>--<span class="w"> </span>pytest<span class="w"> </span>tests/test_parser.py<span class="w"> </span>-q
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">command</span><span class="w"> </span>--<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>compileall<span class="w"> </span>taskledger
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">command</span></code> records command exit code and output in planning diagnostics.
With transcript logging enabled, the same output is also captured in the
ledger-level command transcript. Use it to build evidence into the plan before
proposal.</p>
</section>
<section id="materialize-todos-and-approve">
<h2>6. Materialize Todos And Approve</h2>
<p>Plans can include todos in front matter, or todos can be added manually. Approval
may also materialize structured plan todos:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>materialize-todos<span class="w"> </span>--version<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2</span><span class="w"> </span>--dry-run
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>accept<span class="w"> </span>--version<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2</span><span class="w"> </span>--note<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Ready to implement.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>list
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Add parser regression tests.&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--mandatory
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Update parser error message docs.&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--optional
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>status
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Mandatory todos gate implementation completion. Optional todos remain visible but
do not block <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">finish</span></code>.</p>
<p>If the project has an enabled worker pipeline, plan todos may optionally target
configured worker steps. This is an advisory overlay, not a new lifecycle stage:</p>
<div class="highlight-yaml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nt">todos</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nt">id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">plan-todo-0001</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">text</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;Add</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">failing</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">regression</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">tests.&quot;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">worker_step</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;tester&quot;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">validation_hint</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;pytest</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">tests/test_parser.py</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">-q&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use the worker overlay explicitly:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>pipeline<span class="w"> </span>next
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--worker<span class="w"> </span>tester
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span>--worker<span class="w"> </span>tester<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Add failing tests only.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>All approval escape hatches require <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--reason</span></code>:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-empty-criteria</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-open-questions</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-empty-todos</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-materialize-todos</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
<p>Without a reason, the approval command will fail.</p>
</section>
<section id="start-implementation">
<h2>7. Start Implementation</h2>
<p>Begin implementation and keep durable notes as work progresses:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>can<span class="w"> </span>implement
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>implementation<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>start
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>checklist
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>log<span class="w"> </span>--message<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Started parser fix.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">command</span><span class="w"> </span>--<span class="w"> </span>pytest<span class="w"> </span>tests/test_parser.py<span class="w"> </span>-q
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>change<span class="w"> </span>--path<span class="w"> </span>taskledger/parser.py<span class="w"> </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span>edit<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Reject unmatched delimiters with source offsets.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>change<span class="w"> </span>--path<span class="w"> </span>tests/test_parser.py<span class="w"> </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">test</span><span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Added nested expression and delimiter regression tests.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>deviation<span class="w"> </span>--message<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Kept tokenizer unchanged because parser-level validation is sufficient.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>artifact<span class="w"> </span>--path<span class="w"> </span>.taskledger-artifacts/parser-test-output.txt<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Parser regression test output.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>scan-changes<span class="w"> </span>--from-git<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Implementation diff summary.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>status
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">command</span></code> when you want taskledger to record a command run as
part of implementation. With transcript logging enabled, it also records managed
stdout/stderr in the task transcript. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">deviation</span></code> when the
implementation differs from the approved plan.</p>
<section id="fresh-worker-implementation">
<h3>Fresh-worker implementation</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span>--mode<span class="w"> </span>implementation<span class="w"> </span>--todo<span class="w"> </span>todo-0003
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>implementer<span class="w"> </span>--todo<span class="w"> </span>todo-0003
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="complete-implementation-todos">
<h2>8. Complete Implementation Todos</h2>
<p>Mark mandatory todos done with evidence:</p>
<p>Compact same-session loop:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>next-action
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>next
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>todo-0003
<span class="c1"># implement only that todo</span>
pytest<span class="w"> </span>tests/test_parser.py<span class="w"> </span>-q
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span><span class="k">done</span><span class="w"> </span>todo-0003<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pytest tests/test_parser.py -q&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>next-action
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Prefer this loop over broad generated context during normal work. Use
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validation_hint</span></code> before marking a todo done. Create a handoff or wider
context only when the task needs a harness or session switch.</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>next
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span><span class="k">done</span><span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pytest tests/test_parser.py -q&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--artifact<span class="w"> </span>.taskledger-artifacts/parser-test-output.txt
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span><span class="k">done</span><span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Reviewed parser docs.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span>status
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>finish<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Implemented parser delimiter rejection and tests.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Todo source is inferred from the active lock: todos added during implementation
are recorded as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source=implementer</span></code>, during planning as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source=planner</span></code>,
and outside an active stage as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source=user</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">finish</span></code> releases the implementation lock only when mandatory todos
are complete.</p>
</section>
<section id="validate-the-work">
<h2>9. Validate The Work</h2>
<p>Start validation, run checks against each acceptance criterion, and finish the
validation stage:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>can<span class="w"> </span>validate
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>validation<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>start
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>status
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--criterion<span class="w"> </span>ac-0001<span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>pass<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pytest tests/test_parser.py -q&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--criterion<span class="w"> </span>ac-0002<span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>pass<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pytest tests/test_parser.py -q&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>show
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>finish<span class="w"> </span>--result<span class="w"> </span>passed<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Parser fix validated with regression tests.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="if-validation-finds-a-bug">
<h3>If validation finds a bug</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--criterion<span class="w"> </span>ac-0002<span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>fail<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pytest tests/test_parser.py -q&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>finish<span class="w"> </span>--result<span class="w"> </span>failed<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;ac-0002 failed.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>next-action
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>implementation<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>restart<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Fix ac-0002 validation failure.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>If a criterion is intentionally not validated, a user can waive it:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>waive<span class="w"> </span>--criterion<span class="w"> </span>ac-0003<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Covered by upstream integration test.&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--actor<span class="w"> </span>user
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Waivers should be rare and explicit.</p>
</section>
<section id="fresh-worker-review">
<h3>Fresh-worker review</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>spec-reviewer<span class="w"> </span>--run<span class="w"> </span>run-0008
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>code-reviewer<span class="w"> </span>--run<span class="w"> </span>run-0008
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="close-the-task">
<h2>10. Close The Task</h2>
<p>After validation passes, close the task and inspect final state:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>dossier<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span>--mode<span class="w"> </span>validation<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Parser fix is implemented and validated.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>HANDOFF_ID<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>text
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>close<span class="w"> </span>--note<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Fixed parser delimiter handling and validated parser regressions.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>tag<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">0</span>.4.2<span class="w"> </span>--at-task<span class="w"> </span>parser-fix<span class="w"> </span>--note<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;0.4.2 released.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>show
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>parser-fix
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>status<span class="w"> </span>--full
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>After validation passes, the task is in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">done</span></code> state. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">close</span></code> is a
final acknowledgement command for an already-done task. Release boundaries are
tracked by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">tag</span></code>. The dossier and handoff commands preserve
a fresh-context summary for future agents or reviewers.</p>
<section id="post-completion-follow-up-deltas">
<h3>Post-completion follow-up deltas</h3>
<p>When the original task is complete and a later small delta is needed, keep the
parent task closed and create a new follow-up child task:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>follow-up<span class="w"> </span>parser-fix<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Rename parser error copy&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--description<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Small post-completion delta.&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--activate
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>start
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>upsert<span class="w"> </span>--file<span class="w"> </span>./plan.md
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>accept<span class="w"> </span>--version<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span><span class="w"> </span>--note<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Approved tiny follow-up delta.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use the normal lifecycle on the follow-up task. Do not reopen the completed
parent task for ordinary deltas.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="recovery-and-maintenance-commands">
<h2>11. Recovery And Maintenance Commands</h2>
<p>These commands are not part of the happy path, but they complete the operational
cycle:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>lock<span class="w"> </span>show
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor<span class="w"> </span>locks
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>lock<span class="w"> </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Recover stale planning lock.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>resume<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Reacquire implementation lock for existing running run.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>uncancel<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Restore the task to a safe durable stage.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>repair<span class="w"> </span>index
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>repair<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Inspect task record after manual edit.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>reindex
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>snapshot<span class="w"> </span>./taskledger-snapshot<span class="w"> </span>--include-bodies<span class="w"> </span>--include-run-artifacts
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Locks are never cleared silently. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock</span> <span class="pre">break</span></code> only after inspecting the
lock and recording a reason. If a broken stale lock leaves an implementation run
still marked <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">running</span></code>, continue with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">resume</span></code> instead of starting a
new implementation run. If a task is truly <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cancelled</span></code>, use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">uncancel</span></code>
to restore a safe durable stage before re-entering planning, implementation, or
validation through the normal stage-specific commands. After <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">uncancel</span></code>,
run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code> again; if it reports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement-resume</span></code>, reacquire the
existing implementation run rather than running <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="task-centered-traceability">
<h2>Task-centered traceability</h2>
<p>Taskledger owns temporal work truth: task history, plans, acceptance criteria,
implementation changes, validation checks, reviews, locks, and handoffs.
Cross-ledger links are opaque file or ID references.</p>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">trace</span> <span class="pre">TASK</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code> to emit a read-only
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.trace.v1</span></code> task bundle. The bundle links task IDs, accepted AC IDs,
opaque link refs, source refs, evidence refs, changes, reviews, and handoffs.</p>
<p>Evidence import is explicit and auditable through
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">check</span> <span class="pre">--criterion</span> <span class="pre">...</span> <span class="pre">--status</span> <span class="pre">...</span> <span class="pre">--evidence</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code>.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
